findings.title: Recheck evidence is not bound to the finding it clears
findings.evidence: blockers() validates that the cited artifact is sealed and has a matching reviewer recheck event, but never checks that the artifact or event names finding_id. One recheck artifact can clear every blocking finding in the folder. README discloses that evidence justification is unchecked.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Recheck events carry finding ids; verified-fixed clears only when the cited event lists that finding_id. Test with one artifact cited by two findings.

findings.title: Installed skill copy identity not evidenced
findings.evidence: The packet supplies only the register SKILL.md. The report claims installed Codex and Claude copies are reviewed extra scope, but no hashes for those copies were provided, so byte-identity is unverified.
findings.acceptance_criteria: inputs.json lists both installed copies with sha256 equal to the register copy.

findings.title: Disposition vocabulary declared but not enforced at write time
findings.evidence: DISPOSITIONS is defined but unused; validate() checks ROLES only for ledger events. A misspelled disposition or actor in dispositions.jsonl commits successfully and remains permanently unresolved rather than being rejected before it enters append-only history.
findings.acceptance_criteria: validate() rejects unknown disposition values or roles in newly appended rows only, preserving committed history. Test for a typo row.
